title: Missions
body:
Syntax: mission info | missions

Description: Mission info shows active objectives, enemy mob names/levels/VNUMs, progress and the 30-minute countdown. Missions lists posted D-Rank jobs when standing at a village mission board. Hunt missions are available via mission request <rank> anywhere.\n\nCourier option: MISSION REQUEST DELIVERY <rank>. You receive a mission-bound sealed parcel to deliver to a real village NPC.
